expected_behavior: Points browser.exe to the new build and runs sbtest.tools.doctor first
Runs python run.py --sanity and reads report/index.html for the verdict
Reports BUILD PASSED/FAILED with the selection that was run

query: Run bookmarks and downloads, then publish the report to Confluence under 'SB QA / Sanity'
expected_behavior: Creates the page with the Confluence skill from confluence/ (manifest title, page.storage.html, all attachments)
Adds a Triage section when there are failures and replies with the page link

query: 3 tests failed last night, which are real bugs?
expected_behavior: Reads failure.txt, page.png and screen.png of each failure
Puts every failure in exactly one bucket (regression / UI changed / environment / flaky)
Re-runs with --reruns 1 to separate flakes and never adds sleeps
